announcements.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
announcements.snippet: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

announcements.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
announcements.snippet: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

announcements.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
announcements.snippet: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and bringing AI into teaching and learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.

announcements.title: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
announcements.snippet: Cult.fit is using Codex to help teams across functions build tools, move faster, and change how work gets done.

announcements.title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
announcements.snippet: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. Its teams also use AI to plan executive dinners and prepare sales updates.

announcements.title: Flipsnack grows product signups with conversion optimization
announcements.snippet: Flipsnack focused its ChatGPT Ads campaigns on getting people to try its product, growing registrations while lowering the cost per signup.

announcements.title: Franklin Templeton uses OpenAI to support investment research
announcements.snippet: Starting with equity research, Franklin Templeton is developing AI workflows to help portfolio managers compare research views and examine investment risks.
